op.title: The operator wants to run a command
choices.heading: Your answer
choices.applied: Applied on the host at once, as the operator. The PM is told and does not ask you again.
choice.once.title: Approve once
choice.once.detail: Runs this command now. The next command asks again.
choice.similar.title: Approve + allow similar for the session
choice.similar.detail: Runs it now, then lets this command or commands that start the same way run without asking.
choice.auto.title: Auto-approve all
choice.auto.detail: Runs it now and opens a window that approves almost everything, for 1 hour or this session.
scope.title: Allow similar commands
scope.exact.title: This exact command
scope.exact.detail: Only the command above, exactly as written.
scope.prefix.title: Commands that start with:
scope.rule: A grant matches whole words. Pushes and deletes still ask.
scope.length: Lasts for this session, up to the host's grant limit.
auto.title: Auto-approve all
auto.hour.title: For 1 hour
auto.hour.end: Lasts up to 1 hour (less when the host's limit is shorter).
auto.session.title: For this session
auto.session.end: Lasts until the host's configured limit.
auto.end.both: Both end when the controller restarts or when the window is revoked with cstan op revoke at the terminal.
auto.coverage.heading: What the window approves
auto.coverage: The window approves every Operator command and every worker permission prompt, pushes and deletes included, except the floor list: deletes or writes outside the project, and a controller restart. Scripts and shells are approved unchecked. Web fetch, MCP and other tool prompts are answered without a floor check.
auto.confirm.title: Open an auto-approve window?
limited.lead: Only Approve once and Deny are offered.
limited.floor: This command matches the host's floor list, so it is approved one at a time.
limited.restart: A controller restart is approved one at a time.
limited.truncated: The command is longer than the app can show (the first 4096 bytes are shown), so it can only be approved at the terminal.
limited.not_checked: This proposal was made before the host could check it against the floor list, so it is approved one at a time.
limited.text_mismatch: The command does not match its hash, so it can only be denied.
result.once: Approved once. The operator runs it now.
result.grant: Approved, and allowed for this session:
result.window.revoke: Revoke it at the terminal with cstan op revoke.
result.pm: The PM was told and does not ask you again.
refusal.busy: The operator is running a command. Try again when it finishes.
refusal.not_waiting: This proposal is no longer waiting. It was answered elsewhere or it expired.
refusal.hash_mismatch: The command changed since you opened it. Read it again before you answer.
refusal.needs_terminal: The host no longer offers this choice for this command. Approve once, deny, or answer at the terminal.
refusal.invalid_request: The host did not accept this answer.
oldhost.note: Deny is applied on the host now. Approve goes to the project manager, who confirms with you and runs it.
